# Library types

Which library content types (CollectionType) Tinyfin can create and scan. Any value is accepted when a library is created; only the types below are scanned, the rest are skipped with a log line.

[Overview](../COVERAGE.md) · 11 features · ✅ 5 · 🟡 2 · 🗓️ 1 · ⛔ 3
